reason: The text contains multiple named characters who are regular people: Abram (אַבְרָם), his wife Sarai (שָׂרַי), and his nephew Lot (לוֹט). These individuals are explicitly identified by name and are portrayed as ordinary human beings engaged in mundane activities (traveling, taking possessions, building altars). While Abram receives a divine calling, he is presented as a human character responding to God's commands rather than a divine or supernatural being.
